scope: Bounded queued streaming for the PPLX WebGPU backend

execution.default: Queued when WebGPU prefetch is enabled and per-layer profiling is off
execution.completion: Queue completion callbacks; CPU waits only for weight-bank reuse and final drain
execution.cleanup: Each submission owns its uniforms, temporary buffers and converted/quantized weights until collection
execution.fallback: Prefetch disabled, configuration.queued=false, and per-layer profiling retain synchronized execution; resident execution is unchanged
execution.timing: encode_enqueue_ms and queue_wait_ms are CPU wall times; compute_ms and pack_ms are null; submission_to_collection_ms is not GPU compute duration

validation.runtime_checks: Two submissions before first collection; bounded banks; serial parity; multiple chunks and requests; delayed reads; read/encoding/completion failures; draining before reset/dispose; successful retries

weight_buffers.scope: raw BF16 weight banks; excludes active converted/quantized weights and activations
weight_buffers.overlap: uploads enqueued after compute submission and before its completion wait; hardware overlap is implementation-dependent

limitations: SwiftShader correctness validation; physical transfer/compute overlap and hardware speedup are unmeasured
FP16/INT8/Q4 paths compile but GPU validation requires shader-f16, unavailable on this adapter
Full-checkpoint parity covers one saved fixture, not a task-quality evaluation
Raw weight-bank memory excludes up to two in-flight layer working sets, activations and existing bounded reuse pools
This is the low-memory streaming path; an all-resident single-submission decoder is not implemented

provenance.runtime_difference: Adapter timing description only; queue scheduling is unchanged

reproduce.worker: Repeat the streaming page with worker=1
